■ Mana Drive 7 (Light): When you put this creature into the battle zone, if you have 7 or more cards in your mana zone and one or more of them is light civilization, you may destroy this creature. If you do, use this creature's MD ability.

MD カードを1枚引く。その後、自分の手札を1枚裏向きのまま、新しいシールドとして自分のシールドゾーンに置く。
